exact_consumption.paired_root_scope: Only PA/CF at the same source leaf and same true r,w, with all H/Kbar/Kbar_r modes stored. Old candidate comparisons remain the certified original complete-mean absolute bounds.
exact_consumption.real_line: Interpolate the entire real state (c,Kbar,P,T) between the two exact complete roots. Intermediate states need not be roots. A and D are concave along that line, L is affine, so endpoint true lower bounds prove the whole line remains in the real positive domain.
exact_consumption.zero_modes: Subtract exactly 1 from B_K and B_T using zero means of delta Kbar and delta T. All frequency multipliers m and m^2 are paid from full saved H coefficient differences.
exact_consumption.coefficients: Use theorem M.12--M.14 with exact Fraction arithmetic, E*=1+w_max^2, A_min, D0=min(1,D_min), L_min and full real Fourier absolute sums. Take min of this root-difference bound and the original sum only because both bound the same PA/CF root difference.
exact_consumption.complete_radial_mean: G=(Gamma-1)/z is evaluated algebraically as YT/(A sqrt(D))+d/(sqrt(D)(1+sqrt(D))), d=2K+K^2+E P^2. G_z retains all four exact terms; no small-w inverse is introduced. P_r and T_r use actual Kbar angular derivatives and 1/r+w_r/w. Kbar_r comes from actual compatible candidate derivatives, never from the PDE.
exact_consumption.radial_product_difference: All coefficient differences use exact positive telescoping products on the same real A/D/L domain. The denominator difference times the original c_r is retained. No third radial derivative, new mean root, angular sampling or new source integration is used.
